metric_name: Primary Outcome Exclusions Due to Missingness
forensic_finding: Observed missing count in standardized primary outcome gsed_Z is 312 (307 raw unassessed + 5 in single-observation age bins with undefined standard deviation). Reported 332 exclusions overstates actual exclusions by 20 participants.
Observed sample with valid standardized primary outcome gsed_Z is exactly 2149, matching the reported primary analysis sample of 2,149.

The apparent discrepancy (2,461 - 332 = 2,129 != 2,149) arose from a 20-unit error in reported exclusions: 2,461 enrolled - 312 actual exclusions = 2,149 primary analysis sample. No raw outcome definition in the dataset yields 332 missing values.
2154 participants have raw GSED d-score recorded; 307 are missing (12.47%).
2148 participants have age-adjusted DAZ score recorded; 313 are missing (12.72%).
